The details that help

Less hunting.
More doing.

01

Find the window you meant

Preview an app’s windows, then focus the one you want. You can also minimise or close an individual window.

02

Keep your favourites in reach

Pin the apps you use most. They stay in the taskbar, even when they are not running.

03

Work across screens

Put a taskbar on each screen, with windows relevant to that display and your current Space.

TaskLane / Light appearance

Fit it to your desk.

Choose the position, size and appearance. Place the taskbar at the bottom, top or side, and choose how your app icons are arranged.

  • Bottom, top, left or right
  • Light and dark appearances
  • Pinned and running apps
  • Clock and date display

Installation

Settle in, in a few steps.

Download the public release from GitHub. TaskLane is distributed outside the Mac App Store.

  1. Download

    Open the release page and choose the DMG or ZIP asset.

  2. Install

    Open the DMG and drag TaskLane into Applications, or extract the ZIP.

  3. Open

    The published release is not notarized by Apple. macOS may show a warning on first launch. Review its origin and follow the instructions on the release page.

Two permissions, two purposes.

TaskLane needs these permissions for the corresponding window features. Without them, window names, previews or controls are limited.

Screen Recording
To read window names and display window thumbnails.
Accessibility
To focus, minimise and close individual windows.

FAQ

A few useful answers.

Why does macOS show a warning?+

The published release is not notarized by Apple. The release notes explain the first launch. Review the public code and the release source before deciding whether to open it.

What happens to my data?+

TaskLane works locally. It does not collect data or connect to the internet. Its source code is available on GitHub. This website also uses no cookies or analytics.

Can I hide the macOS Dock?+

Yes. In System Settings → Desktop & Dock, enable “Automatically hide and show the Dock” if you prefer to keep it out of the way.

Which macOS version do I need?+

macOS 15 (Sequoia) or later. The currently published v0.5.0 executable requires macOS 15, even though older release notes mention macOS 14.

Where can I report a problem?+

Use the GitHub issue tracker. Include your macOS version, TaskLane release and the steps that reproduce the issue. Issues are public: leave out private window titles or personal information.
